prompts.prompt:
We are testing FlightPath queue-append via VS Code Chat Language Model Tools or MCP, which ever is available to you.

Call the tool "flightpath_append_queue" to append TWO simple prompts:
1) Append a prompt at the NEXT position (position="next").
2) Append another prompt at the END (position="end").

Use parameters shaped like:
{
  "position": "next" | "end",
  "prompts": [ { "prompt": "..." } ],
  "source": "manual-test",
  "reason": "manual test of append tool"
}

Make the two appended prompt texts very simple, e.g. "APPENDED NEXT: say hello" and "APPENDED END: say goodbye".

After appending, do not edit any files; just proceed.
Now call the tool "flightpath_queue_status" (no parameters needed) and output the returned JSON status.
